__doc: Aider Configuration File - Main settings for the AI assistant
__section_comment_1: The following settings control code generation behavior

coding_guidelines.description: Standards to follow when writing or modifying code
rules: Functions and methods should accept flexible parameters - a function accepting `string[]` parameter should also accept a `string` parameter and covert it to a `string[]`
All code should be as generalizable as possible for future reuse

_documentation: Git conventions section defines how commits should be structured
These are important for maintaining a clean repository history
git_conventions: Write descriptive commit messages with prefixes (feat:, fix:, etc.)

metadata.notes: This configuration emphasizes code quality and consistent style for PK TypeScript libraries
